digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 / Reconciler vendor adapter capability detection
propositions: isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols silently fail on Python 3.12+ due to CPython gh-102433 switching to inspect.getattr_static, which does not see dynamically-proxied attributes.
ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability detection, which was safe on Python 3.11 but became unsafe on 3.12+ — a version boundary temporal decay, not an authoring error.
Dynamically-proxying transport objects satisfy a capability but fail isinstance checks on 3.12+, causing silent skips of writes and soft failures.

All executable isinstance-against-Protocol sites in src/rebar are already proxy-hardened: dispatch_apply_phases.py:188 uses isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback; _backend.py:213 overrides __instancecheck__ with all-hasattr.
ADR-0083 amendment required to document that isinstance is necessary-but-not-sufficient on 3.12+ and prescribe the isinstance-primary plus member-hasattr-fallback guard shape.
